artifact_version: VN Companion RC29.137 · Guide Save Fix
capabilities_changed: Guide Save writes only the fields the form edits; no longer wipes worth star rating, notes, price, bookingNote, etc.
Day 5 Shopping card gets a Maison Marou Guide button (guideGroups on the card; shopping cards now render explicit guideGroups).
Removed five unused Guides and all references: nha-suga, moc-healing, mojo-spa, thao-dien-spa, golden-lotus-thao-dien.

Save & Sync: one durable pending-mutation queue (save-sync-queue.js) shared by Booking, Guide and Timeline; local write is read-back verified before anything is claimed; 'Saved & Synced ✓' only after cloud read-back verification, otherwise 'Saved locally · Sync pending'.
Timeline Save now syncs to Supabase automatically (reuses publish_trip_snapshot; no Publish step; Studio credential stays in memory only) with stale-write merge by item id and read-back verification.
Guide sync: compare-and-set on remote updated_at, three-way field merge, read-back verification; pulls never clobber unsynced local edits.
Booking: user-edited fields (_editedFields) are replayed over a new deploy master, so manual time/venue/notes/blank edits survive deployments; read-back verifies status/date/time/venue/reference.
Published snapshots now carry itineraryBase and are rebased onto a newer master instead of discarded after a deployment.
Admin Save no longer clears the draft unless the local commit was verified.
CI: fixture-driven invariant suite (ci-tests/invariants); itinerary-content snapshot tests reclassified as advisory (non-gating).
explicitly_deferred: plannedVisits EditableStateFields vs future deploy-master changes
obsolete_or_rejected: historical shared Trip/Guide overlay geometry ownership

RC29.125 (documented retroactively): Booking Notes from a real remote row are authoritative for cross-device sync; a Booking save is only reported as synced after the remote row carries the user-edited Notes and plannedVisits.

RC29.125 (documented retroactively): plannedDays/plannedVisits are editable booking state fields; the Booking editor exposes per-visit Day/Date/Time fields; Booking Save commits locally first and queues remote sync afterwards.
